title: The Secret of the Snowy Mountain
intro: This quiz checks what you learned about pressure, weight, thrust, and force.

questions.prompt: Why do snowshoes help a person sink less deeply into soft snow?
choices: They spread the same force over a larger area
They decrease the force of gravity
questions.explanation: Snowshoes spread the same force over a larger area, which lowers pressure and reduces sinking.

questions.prompt: What is the formula for pressure?
questions.explanation: Pressure is force divided by area: P = F / A.

choices: The amount of matter in an object
The gravitational force acting on an object
The area covered by an object
The pressure produced by an object
questions.explanation: Weight is the gravitational force acting on an object (W = mg).

choices: A force acting parallel to a surface
A force acting perpendicular to a surface
questions.explanation: Thrust is a force acting perpendicular (at 90°) to a surface.

questions.prompt: A box applies a force of 50 N over an area of 0.1 m². What pressure does it produce?
questions.explanation: Pressure = Force ÷ Area = 50 N ÷ 0.1 m² = 500 Pa.
